item.title: Three people evaluated for possible carbon monoxide exposure in Hyannis
item.description: HYANNIS – Three people were evaluated for possible exposure to carbon monoxide in Hyannis. Crews responded to a Birch Street residence about 9:30 AM Thursday. National Grid was on scene and an apparently faulty heating system was shut down until repairs could be made. All three people declined to go to the hospital.
